column1: # Maisse's Cipher (1592), BnF fr.16093 — key published by S. Tomokiyo (cryptiana,
# "French Ciphers during the Reign of Henry IV", henryiv_Maisse1.png, "Cipher used in
# BnF fr.16093 f.317"). Simple substitution, 22-letter alphabet (i=j, u=v), plus doubles.
# Added 23 Oct 2026 (r2f) from the f. 370 figures aligned with the Brienne 13 copy (texts/f370_figures_vs_copy.md), grade C:
# 73 was entered above as uu from Tomokiyo's table (unlabelled there under u); f. 370v 'a 73 endant' = attendant gives tt,
# and 71 rr / 72 ss / 73 tt keep the alphabetical order of the doubles. 90 (f. 370r l. 1, line end) unidentified, probably a null.
